diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: The `dismiss-tap` fired at (200, 200) after each claim to close the reward popup is landing directly on the DAILY SPECIAL OFFERS sidebar tab (which occupies approximately x=50–300, y=150–300), switching the view away from LST HUNT; subsequent rounds find no claim badges because they're scanning the wrong tab, and the cooldown OCR reads 0 timers for the same reason — all from the same misplaced coordinate.
